race.comment: STEEL TSUNAMI (8) dug deep third-up when putting it all together to get the job done at Murray Bridge. Is open to further improvement and gets in light with the 3kg claim. Can make it two on the bounce from the good draw. POLUNIN (12) is lightly raced and still figuring it all out. Can cross quickly to find a spot from a sticky draw and give a bold sight. Win won't shock. THERMODYNAMIC (9) returns short of a preferred trip but has good early speed and should give a sight. THE COSMIC ONE (5) was a dominant winner fresh when leading all the way. Didn't handle the conditions last time when dropping out but is worth forgiving. Draws well and should be in this for a long way.
